data.transcript: The great thing about OTT is it's always gonna sound good. It's just the greatest, I love it! The only challenge with OTT is not using it literally on every sound. Great advice: simple is better 100% of the time. That's something that I try to tell myself and don't always listen to myself. Find out what makes you unique and stick with it. If I'm stoked, that's the best I can do. You know, I just use myself as a testing ground. The more I try to affect a sub bass, the more it can take the juice out of it in one way or another. In general, I'm pretty sparing with reverb and delay. Like, dry on my drums, and I try to never do anything on the master. A lot of the stuff you make will just end up on the hard drive. You have to just keep creating, keep making, make that one special idea.
